about.title: About & Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: DriveReady India stores your settings and progress only on this device (in your browser's local storage). We do not ask for or collect Aadhaar, licence numbers, phone numbers or other sensitive data. No account is needed. If optional sync is added in future, it will be clearly opt-in. Use 'Reset all progress' in Profile to erase your data.
disclaimer: Independent practice app, not affiliated with MoRTH, Parivahan, Sarathi or any RTO. Always check official sources for current rules.
